bases.name: Source & Intake Corpus
bases.purpose: Сырые входные источники с provenance и статусом; не являются автоматически утверждёнными знаниями.

bases.name: Canonical Project KB
bases.purpose: Утверждённые project facts, glossary, scope, packs, versions.

bases.name: Data & Integration KB
bases.purpose: Data models, schemas, APIs, events, pipelines, migrations.

bases.name: Security KB
bases.purpose: Threats, controls, IAM, secrets, DLP/PII, security tests.

bases.name: Regulatory / Policy KB
bases.purpose: Verified laws, internal policies, applicability and effective dates.

bases.name: Quality / Eval KB
bases.purpose: Test strategies, golden sets, RAG/LLM evaluation, quality gates.

bases.name: Operations / SRE KB
bases.purpose: SLO, observability, runbooks, sizing, HA/DR, incidents.

bases.name: Sizing / FinOps KB
bases.purpose: Workload models, benchmarks, TCO, budgets, unit economics.

bases.name: Code / Engineering KB
bases.purpose: Approved coding conventions, repo maps, APIs, reusable components and implementation evidence.

bases.name: Evidence Store
bases.purpose: Validation reports, test evidence, benchmarks, screenshots, hashes, release evidence.
